domain_context: This scenario involves reconciling financial instrument identifiers from different regional and international systems. Each identifier refers to the same financial instrument but is recorded differently depending on the standard (ISIN, CUSIP, FIGI, or SEDOL).

predicate_verbalization.isin: The ISIN code arg0 identifies a financial instrument named arg1, described as arg2, issued in country arg3, of type arg4.
predicate_verbalization.cusip: The CUSIP code arg0 identifies a financial instrument named arg1, described as arg2, issued in country arg3, of type arg4.
predicate_verbalization.figi: The FIGI code arg0 identifies a financial instrument named arg1, described as arg2, issued in country arg3, of type arg4.
predicate_verbalization.sedol: The SEDOL code arg0 identifies a financial instrument named arg1, described as arg2, issued in country arg3, of type arg4.
predicate_verbalization.id: Identifier arg1 refers to instrument arg0, named arg2, described as arg3, issued in country arg4, of type arg5.
predicate_verbalization.link: Link between identifiers arg0 and arg1 for instrument ID

rule_verbalization.1: If a financial instrument is identified via ISIN code arg0 and described by name arg1, description arg2, issued in arg3, and of type arg4, then it exists a unique ID argX using the Id predicate.
rule_verbalization.2: If a financial instrument is identified via CUSIP code arg0 and described by name arg1, description arg2, issued in arg3, and of type arg4, then it exists a unique ID argX using the Id predicate.
rule_verbalization.3: If a financial instrument is identified via FIGI code arg0 and described by name arg1, description arg2, issued in arg3, and of type arg4, then it exists a unique ID argX using the Id predicate.
rule_verbalization.4: If a financial instrument is identified via SEDOL code arg0 and described by name arg1, description arg2, issued in arg3, and of type arg4, then it exists a unique ID argX using the Id predicate.
rule_verbalization.5: If two financial instruments are identified, and both share the same name arg2, description arg3, issued in country arg4, and of type arg5, then their IDs must be merged.
rule_verbalization.Q: If two identifiers refer to the same internal instrument ID, then a Link is created between those identifiers.
